notes: The third trkpt carries a literal empty <ele></ele> element pair -- the parser landmine that crashes an unsanitised Dart GpxReader on load (FormatException: Invalid double) rather than disagreeing on the value. parseElevation() must treat this identically to a wholly-omitted <ele>, i.e. undefined, so the elevation anchor carries forward across it rather than treating it as a plunge to 0m sea level.
